posts.text:
The American people are sick and tired of the chaos, high costs and extreme Republican agenda.

Donald Trump must end his reckless war of choice in the Middle East.

Now.

Chag Pesach Sameach to everyone celebrating in Brooklyn and throughout the nation!

May this be a meaningful holiday and a season inspired by the freedom, resilience and hope of the Jewish people across generations.
Statement on the Trump-Republican DHS Shutdown.

Republicans plan to pay for Donald Trump’s reckless war of choice by cutting billions from healthcare and SNAP.

The GOP did the same thing last year to fund ICE brutality and violence.

Every single one of these extremists is unfit to govern.

Video

Republicans are complete phonies with their voter suppression scheme.

#TrumpVotedByMail

Gas is over $4 a gallon.

Donald Trump’s reckless war of choice is making your life more expensive.

You deserve better.

There is a bipartisan bill to end the chaos at airports.

House Republicans rejected it and left town on vacation.

Bring the House back. End the GOP shutdown.

NOW.

Republicans created chaos at airports across America.

They can end it tomorrow.

Bring the House back. Pass the bipartisan bill. Pay TSA.

The American people deserve better.

Republicans are spending billions of dollars to drop bombs in the Middle East.

Not a dime to extend the Affordable Care Act.

Donald Trump must end his reckless war of choice immediately.

#NoKings

Democrats are fighting to make life more affordable for the American people.

Meanwhile.

Unhinged Republicans in the House and Senate are fighting each other.

Republicans have unleashed chaos at airports throughout the country.

The extremists are intentionally inconveniencing millions of Americans as we approach Easter and Passover.

This needs to end today.

Republicans are forcing TSA agents to work without pay and causing chaos at airports throughout America.

Meanwhile.

ICE agents are being paid by Donald Trump to stand around and do nothing.

Video

Gas prices are skyrocketing in America as a direct result of the reckless Republican war of choice in the Middle East.

Enough.

Donald Trump voted by mail in today’s special election in Florida.

Republicans want to take this right away from everyone else.

These extremists are complete and total phonies.

Video

Taxpayer dollars should be used to make your life more affordable.

Meanwhile.

Republicans are spending billions to drop bombs in a reckless war of choice in the Middle East.

#HealthcareNotWarfare

Trump Tariffs. Health Insurance Costs. Gas Prices. ICE Brutality. Reckless War.

Republicans have made America much less affordable and significantly more dangerous.

How is that Golden Age thingy working out?
